The animal has a long, tubular body with brown fur on its back and cream/white fur on its underside. It has short legs, a pointed snout, small dark eyes, and a relatively long tail with a black tip. The background consists of blurred vegetation and earth.

The front legs merge slightly into the rocky ground texture. Individual toes are not clearly defined, appearing as smooth stumps. This is a common AI weakness in rendering small digits on rough terrain.
